description: This file contains implementation of fused Adam optimizer kernel functions optimized for Apple Metal Performance Shaders (MPS). It includes function definitions for applying fused Adam updates, referencing external shader libraries, and retrieving Metal pipeline states.

methods.name: _fused_adam_mps_impl_
methods.description: Performs fused Adam optimizer update across multiple tensors for MPS backend, with overloads for TensorList and Tensor references.

methods.name: getFusedAdamCPLState
methods.description: Retrieves Metal pipeline state and function objects for a given fused Adam kernel name.
